package.name: iad_control
package.description: Standalone trajectory tracking for heavy vehicles with actuator dead time: LTV lateral MPC (ADMM QP) with delay compensation, PI + feed-forward longitudinal control (planned acceleration, rolling resistance, grade), gear changes; pure-pursuit baseline. In: autoware_planning_msgs/Trajectory, nav_msgs/Odometry, vehicle status. Out: ackermann_msgs/AckermannDriveStamped. Includes a software-in-the-loop plant.
